caseName: Shields v. Atlantic Coast Line Railroad
caseNameFull: Shields v. Atlantic Coast Line Railroad Co.
attorneys: M. R. Nachman, Jr. for petitioner. Norman C. Shepard for respondent.

opinions.text: *819C. A. 5th Cir. Certiorari granted. The Court calls this case to the attention of the Interstate Commerce Commission and expresses its readiness to accept any brief it might wish to submit.
